orgDesign.companyProfile: Public-cloud services provider serving startups, enterprises, application builders, platform teams, SREs, security teams, FinOps operators, regulated sectors, partners, and procurement stakeholders.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Infrastructure teams own core primitives; managed-platform teams own developer, data, and AI services; trust-and-operations teams own governance, security, observability, and FinOps; enterprise-ecosystem teams own migration, support, documentation, marketplace, and partner adoption.
designPrinciples: Keep compute, storage, networking, and resilience as durable foundations with explicit ownership.
Keep managed application, data, and AI services close to developer activation and workload expansion.
Keep identity, observability, policy, security posture, and FinOps in one operating loop.
Keep migration, marketplace, support, and documentation connected because enterprise adoption depends on the full commercial and implementation path.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for infrastructure services, managed platform services, trust and operations, and enterprise ecosystem.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
